name: u10-live-screen-updates
about: Live screen updates: each change is followed by the open screen re-reading what changed since its position (newest 1 of the kind = changedSince for one change). Measured: founder presentation:read 457,028 over 4 load days (114K/day) vs record writes 117K/day [L]: 0.98 screen re-reads per change, so one screen per change. presentation:subscribe 9,663 / 4 days = 2,416/day founder [L], x K = 43 screen opens/day (a screen open lists the newest 50). Change rate: 400 saves/day (plan A-TYP, same as U01). Sources: [A] 04-every-table-challenged.md; [P] clone queries on o08/o21/o27/o04/o07/o09 (profile-overhead lane, 2026-10-27); [L] clone queries o03 record_log 2026-10-20..22 PDT, o04 namespace_names, o21 account_control_permits operations (4 load days 2026-10-15..23); [S] --seed-from profile: founder o03 2,398,695 current records / 178 kinds, second account o26 24,263 records. Typical sizes come from the second account [S o26] where the kind exists there, else the founder [S o03].
